title: Settlement founding-fusion blend logic
scope: Qualitative founding-fusion blend logic by which the ridge-spur hillfort settlement holds its two parent inheritances through the accepted strand-braid — the remembered founding-era fusion disposition, its status and virtue fields, its syncretic non-lifecycle observance, and its composite dress — together with the settlement founding frame of a founder native to the original culture, his early admission of imperial refugees, and the resulting host-and-member relations; usable for culture and story development without establishing parent-culture content, rites, speech varieties, exchange media, in-world names, faith content, costume detail, compact terms, offices, succession provisions, demography, protagonist facts, or any change to natural System behaviour.
claims: The hybrid settlement culture expresses through WLD-CULTURE-001's strand-braid: this blend logic describes how the braid holds its two parent inheritances, deepening the accepted fabric and replacing nothing.

The settlement's founding-era disposition is remembered as fusion — inherited forms worked into settlement-specific composites — a remembered pattern, variously and disputably held, with no founding occasion, decision, deliberation, or event fixed.

The settlement's founder was a native of the original culture; this is a declared narrow closure of the founder-origin question left open in WLD-CULTURE-002's founder-and-dynasty space, and it closes nothing else.
In the early founding days the founder admitted imperial refugees into the fold to help build the settlement.
Under the founder's leadership there has been unity and mutual respect between the two inheritances — a qualitative settlement-relations condition, not unanimity and not the absence of friction.
Cultural hybridisation between the inheritances is early-stage and ongoing, not complete.

Consequently the original culture is the settlement's host culture and the imperial-descended are guests-turned-members, and the original culture is not suppressed at the settlement; this is a present settlement-relations claim only and does not alter WLD-HISTORY-001's account of the withdrawn power's historical regional administration.

The charter-oath compact is remembered as the model case of the fusion: an oath sworn in what residents call the original manner joined to witnessed, fallibly kept records in what they call the imperial manner (WLD-CULTURE-002; no oath text or written charter exists, and the memory of the founding pairing is itself a cultural reading).

Standing accrues to households and persons seen to embody the joined way, while purists of either inheritance keep real but narrower prestige inside their own circles; the young composite identity is conscious and contested, claimed by some residents and disputed by others.

Under this blend the compact's designed succession ambiguities read as a question of re-performance — whether a successor must re-enact the remembered fusion or may lean on one inheritance's form — sharpening the designed ambiguity and resolving nothing.

The virtue field organises around joining: imperial-attributed esteem for the deliberate, designed act and original-attributed esteem for the binding spoken word reinforce each other in the fusion ideal of the sworn-together work, and both conflict with each parent register's fidelity virtue — what a purist honours as keeping the received form whole, the fusion register suspects as clinging, and the purists return the suspicion, holding the composites shallow; neither side is simply right and both positions are alive inside every strand. The specific parent esteems named here are option-local illustration only, presupposing no sibling option; the accepted parent frames WLD-CULTURE-003 and WLD-CULTURE-004 supply their content.

The settlement virtue this blend carries is the joined work — a thing, an agreement, a household, or a craft piece, made properly of both inheritances and holding — and its shame is unravelling: publicly pulling a shared thing apart into its parent halves, or claiming one inheritance's precedence at a common table; either may be newly minted here or sharpened and re-anchored from a parent register that already prizes made-and-kept work, and neither is claimed as novel against the accepted parent registers.

Faith blends by syncretism as belief practice: deliberately joined observance composites hold the common occasions while devout traditionalists of both inheritances keep older forms in household privacy — coexistence beneath the composite, confirming nothing.
Dress shows a recognisable settlement-specific composite that outsiders read as the hillfort's own rather than as either parent, and marked parent dress survives for household and purist occasions.

Both parent inheritances are genuinely present, each internally varied, and both are honoured as ancestors of the fusion; neither is despised by default, though purists of each resent the other's share, and every accepted attitude position exists somewhere in the settlement.

Hillfort-side perception only: the settlement reads the outlet settlement as the unblended sibling — what its own remembered disposition did not become — at once a foil for settlement pride and an object of quiet admiration for unbroken imperial continuity, and believes the outlet reads it in turn as culturally mixed; the standing rivalry (WLD-EVENT-001) gives the perception its competitive edge as claims of standing, tendencies only; neither perception measures actual composition, and this record establishes no outlet-side fact.

Generational texture: founders remember the fusion as choice and labour and hold it a little anxiously, the walls-born wear it as plain identity more confidently than its makers, and a visible few reach back past the fusion for purer parent forms as fashion or protest, unsettling founders who remember why the joining was made.

'Original-derived' and 'imperial-derived' are attributions settlement people make — cultural recognition, not accurate history, mirroring WLD-LOCATION-004's discipline; a custom believed imperial may be original, and the reverse.
No blend position, register, attitude, or stance is the protagonist's by implication; every strand class and every stance remains open.
All System-practice implications of this record remain cultural layers over unchanged natural law.
boundaries: This record is a forward deepening of WLD-CULTURE-001's declared-open cultural space; it closes only the blend pattern of that record's open dress, faith-pattern, and virtue space, all observance, dress, virtue, and festival content remains open, the strand-braid is neither replaced nor competed with, and every strand's distinct household traditions — imperial-derived ones included — persist untouched, unranked, and unflattened.

Declared narrow closure of the founder-origin question: WLD-CULTURE-002 establishes the founder, his binding founding oath, and his dynasty without fixing the founder's own origin, and this record closes that one question — the founder was a native of the original culture; nothing else closes, and the dynasty's later composition, the origins of every office-holder in the ruling seat, sworn deputy, adjudicator, burden-consent, and oath-witness classes, and every one of the compact's designed first-succession ambiguity classes remain untouched and explicitly still open, as does everything else WLD-CULTURE-002 leaves open.

WLD-CULTURE-002 is cited, never restated: no compact term, office, text, procedure, representation rule, or ambiguity resolution is added here, the resident reading of the compact as the model fusion case is belief about the compact rather than a compact term, and the re-performance reading sharpens the designed succession pressure without establishing any process, candidate, contender, faction, or outcome.

Guests-turned-members and host culture are qualitative settlement-relations descriptions fixing no legal status, tenure, right, admission rule, membership procedure, precedence order, or category, and WLD-CULTURE-002's hearth-based assembly standing — standing follows the household hearth regardless of origin — is cited unchanged, neither narrowed, ranked, nor qualified by them; WLD-CULTURE-001's accepted claim that no strand dissolves and no strand dominates stands unchanged, host culture being a culture-level relations description that ranks, displaces, or subordinates no strand.

The host-culture claim is present settlement relations only: it does not alter, soften, or contradict WLD-HISTORY-001's account of the withdrawn power's historical regional administration, adds no historical phase, cause, policy, date, or event, and establishes nothing about any other community's cultural relations.

The founder frame is standing fact, not a narrated founding scene: no founding occasion, decision, deliberation, negotiation, arrival, admission event, refugee count or proportion, founder name, biography, character, household, or motive is established, and WLD-HISTORY-001 remains the sole authority for the founding range and the wider chronology, with no date finer than its accepted anchors fixed here; the frame consumes WLD-HISTORY-001's disclaimed founding-composition space and extends WLD-LOCATION-001's declared-open founder space, which WLD-CULTURE-002 already fills in part, taking the founder's origin and his early admission of imperial refugees as standing facts with no date, count, proportion, event, or chronology change, and neither record requires a boundary edit.

Unity and mutual respect is a qualitative condition, not unanimity, not the absence of friction, and not a guarantee: purist resentment, boundary suspicion, and generational tension are established as standing pressures inside it, and WLD-CULTURE-001's accepted imperial-inheritance attitude spectrum stands undisturbed and unnarrowed.
Early-stage hybridisation fixes no rate, stage count, endpoint, timetable, generation boundary, or completion, and whether the fusion deepens, stalls, drifts, or reverses remains open.

Fusion, joining, composite, purist, register, host, guest, member, standing, virtue, shame, hillfort, and every other label in this record are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, language, classification, ritual content, institution, office, law, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee, and every in-world name, self-designation, and linguistic logic remains a protected unknown.

Parent-culture content belongs to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/original-kin-hall-season-court-culture and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture; this record fixes no parent-culture content, the standing logics and virtue pairings named here are attribution classes only, and no settlement virtue or shame is claimed novel against the accepted parent registers.

The lifecycle occasions — birth, coming of age, marriage, death — are deliberately unsorted here and belong to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/lifecycle-threshold-witness-rites; this record neither assigns nor excludes them to either register, every observance referenced here is non-lifecycle, and no rite content, trigger, or meaning is fixed.

All speech-variety, literacy, script, and speech-prestige questions belong to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/generational-language-landscape; nothing here establishes a speech variety, vocabulary, phonology, script, or prestige axis.

No monetary, price, or exchange-medium fact appears here; canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/dual-sphere-exchange-media owns exchange media, and rivalry-as-claims-of-standing is a pre-monetary framing compatible with any exchange outcome.

Outlet abstention: only hillfort-side perception is claimed, and this record establishes no outlet-side fact — an abstention of its own, not a denial binding any sibling record; the outlet settlement's internal composition, self-understanding, and relations beyond the standing rivalry are left open here, whatever another accepted record establishes about the outlet stands undisturbed by this record, and WLD-LOCATION-005's framing — 'primarily does not mean exclusively' — stands.

WLD-EVENT-001's accepted rivalry-forward configuration is coloured as perception and argument material only: no rivalry incident, negotiation, embargo occurrence, trade fact, or occurred event of any kind is created, and no standing pressure class is resolved.

WLD-LOCATION-004 continues to govern remnant ground: avoidance stays practical, not ritual, its ritual-conversion hook is not taken, and attributions to either inheritance remain cultural recognition that may be wrong.

WLD-ECOLOGY-004, WLD-ECOLOGY-006, and WLD-GEOGRAPHY-001 are untouched and nothing from their spaces appears here: the spring pulse's mortality-channel-only boundary and every harvest institution stay open, and no calendar, climate value, date, measurement, closure, watch duty, seasonal class, mustering, levy, crying authority, roster, code, enforcement, or sanction is established.
Dress is a composite reading only: no garment, textile, material class, costume detail, craft, or foodway is fixed, and no Earth species, crop, fabric, or artefact is used.

Faith and observance here are belief practice only: the System and Souls are objective architecture that cultures interpret and never confirm, no faith content, cosmology, afterlife idea, metaphysical confirmation, or Soul claim is established, and no observance triggers, gates, guarantees, modifies, or reveals any System event or readout (CAL0 WLD1.0D, UI1.0D, UI1.1D, UI1.2D, RES0.10D).
No institution, office, or standing gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), and no new System mechanic, readout guarantee, constant, notification behaviour, or CAL0 change is created.

No project modelling default is adopted; the series-adopted WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected as a read-only constraint, nothing prenatal appears, and no reincarnate or exceptional individual is named, implied, or alluded to.

The blend is author-side cultural truth, not automatic character knowledge: residents know the remembered founding disposition, the founder's origin, the attributions, and the outlet perception only through ordinary fallible sources — memory, telling, instruction, record — and the remembered fusion is itself a cultural reading that may be wrong in detail.

Purist-and-fusion friction, double-read standing, the re-performance argument, and generational reaching-back are standing pressures at story start, not occurred events; no incident, dispute, observance occurrence, or succession event is established.

No protagonist fact, character, plot, or chapter claim is made, no named faction or named culture is created, the parked sapient pack species remains parked with no development, and returning non-human peoples and other surviving human communities gain no development here.
Every open boundary of every record this one touches stays open, except the single declared narrow closure of the founder-origin question stated above.
story_implications: Later scenes may use the remembered fusion, the founder's origin and his admission of the refugees, host-and-member relations, joined-work standing, purist friction, syncretic common observance, and composite dress, but every particular household, composite, observance occurrence, dispute, belief, and outcome requires its own evidence.

The re-performance reading gives the approaching first succession a live cultural argument — whether a successor must re-enact the remembered fusion or may lean on one inheritance's form — without establishing any process, candidate, or outcome.
Purist-and-fusion friction, double-read standing, and generational reaching-back for purer parent forms are standing pressures at story start, not occurred events.
Every strand class and every blend stance remains an open possible protagonist origin and position for the series contract to choose later.

The blend does not become automatic character knowledge: residents know the remembered founding disposition, the founder's origin, and the attributions only through ordinary fallible sources, and the attributions may be historically wrong.
system_implications: The selected blend logic and the founding frame are an ordinary setting extension; standing, virtue, observance, and dress claims are cultural layers over unchanged natural System behaviour under CAL0 UI1.0D and UI1.2D.

Syncretic observance is belief practice only: the System and Souls are objective architecture that cultures interpret, no observance triggers, gates, guarantees, modifies, or reveals any System event or readout, and no afterlife, Soul, or death claim is made (CAL0 WLD1.0D, UI1.1D, RES0.10D).
No institution, office, or standing gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), and no CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or project-default adoption is created.
research_questions: What the parent inheritances actually contain, and how far the settlement's original-derived and imperial-derived attributions are historically wrong.
How the fusion actually proceeds from its early stage — deepening, stalling, drifting, or reversing — and over what generations.
What the remembered founding disposition actually consisted of as against what occurred, and how the settlement's founding narrative is told, misremembered, and disputed.
How the dynasty's later composition, the office-holders' origins, and the succession's contenders relate to the two inheritances — all still open under WLD-CULTURE-002.
Which register the succession's contenders will claim, and how the re-performance argument is actually argued and adjudicated within WLD-CULTURE-002's open procedure space.
All observance, foodway, costume, craft, and material-class content of the composites and of the surviving parent forms.
What faith contents and cosmologies the syncretic composites carry as belief, and which fallible institutional carriers hold them.
How host-and-member relations are actually expressed in ordinary settlement life, and whether any settlement virtue or shame acquires customary enforcement, and by whom.
How the outlet settlement actually reads specific hillfort practices, and its own internal cultural variety, which this record leaves entirely open.
The direction of generational reaching-back for purer parent forms — fashion, protest, or revival — and what it costs the fusion.
What in-world names, self-designations, and linguistic logic later attach to the settlement, its inheritances, its composites, and its virtues.

author_approval.evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'B — FOUNDING-FUSION' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option B exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set, and in the same review directed the founding frame this record establishes: a founder native to the original culture, his admission of imperial refugees into the fold in the early founding days, unity and mutual respect between the inheritances under his leadership, early-stage ongoing hybridisation, and the original culture as the settlement's unsuppressed host culture with the imperial-descended as guests-turned-members.
